combo.description: All in at Level 6 with E then instantly R them followed by using Q on your target mid air.
Q then near the end of the animation Flash to ensure the Q hits.
To escape you can E your target away from yourself, then Flash in the opposite direction.
Q then AA to proc your passive and E your target back into you if they start to run away.
To help guarantee your Q, E at close range then AA and Q them at their travel destination.
To trade and get your passive AA and Q between AA timers.
To engage use E from max range then Q while they are traveling.
